title: Chapter 367 Descendants Of God
content:
Chapter 367 Descendants Of God

In this way, the Shadow Clan, one of the six powerful clans in the Chaos Realm, officially joined the human race.

As soon as this news came out, it immediately caused a huge wave of waves in the entire Chaos Realm like a deep water bomb.

Countless races were shocked.

At the same time, their attitude towards human race has gradually changed slightly.

In the past, they did not dare to act rashly. After all, who knew whether they could survive after kneeling down and begging for mercy.

But now, with the giant shadow clan taking the lead, they suddenly felt that it was feasible again.

It's just a shame.

But even the powerful clans like the Shadow Clan are already embarrassed, who will care about these small clans?

Thinking of this, the little tribes who had finished the life and death book of the human race finally gave up their faces, rushed to the human race territory, and knelt down and begged for mercy.

Human race, in the Human Emperor Hall.

This was temporarily built by the human race in a short period of time.

Although it is temporary, it is still difficult to hide the domineering and magnificent nature of this palace.

"The Palace Master, except for the Heavenly God Clan, the Divine Power Clan, the Divine Blood Clan, and a small number of races that depend on these three clans, most of the others have come."

Wu Shang spoke respectfully at Lu Xue, who was sitting upright in the dragon position above.

Hearing this answer, Lu Xue couldn't help but lift the corners of her mouth slightly.

"Haha, it seems that these three tribes really plan to fight to the death with our human tribe."

Wu Shang didn't say anything more, but his eyes showed a faint disdain.

Although the human race is not as good as its heyday, it is still more than enough to face these so-called powerful races today.

If they knew each other, they should have come to the Shadow Clan like this and beg for mercy.

Perhaps, their human race may really spare their lives.

After all, the big man had already spoken.

"It's time already."

At this time, Lu Xue said quietly.

Lu Daosheng once said that day that he would only give one day.

Now, it has passed.

The Wushang below nodded slightly.

"Come."

Lu Xue looked out of the hall.

The next moment, a familiar man walked in slowly.

It is the last supreme emperor of the human race in the Chaos Realm.

Now, with the help of human resources, his injuries have basically recovered.

"Lord of the Palace."

When the man saw Lu Xue, he smiled.

He was not dissatisfied with this palace master.

There is no way, the other party gave too much.

Lu Xue glanced at the man, nodded and said in a quiet voice: "In the name of the human race, declare war on the God Clan, the Divine Power Clan, and the Divine Blood Clan."

Declare war!

Finally, it's still here.

It’s time for human race to take revenge!

The man's name is Wang Ziyun, and at this moment, his bloodline began to boil.

From childhood to adulthood, he has always stood behind everyone.

Relying on the core of "Gou", I have been experiencing it step by step.

Now, he doesn't want to be dependent on him anymore, nor does he need to.

"Yes, the Lord of the Palace."

Wang Ziyun clenched his fist, put it in his heart, and beat it twice before leaving.

Immediately afterwards, within the human race, a piece of news instantly spread throughout the Chaos Realm with a surging momentum.

"The human race officially declares war on the Gods, the Divine Powers, and the Divine Blood Clan!"

.........

"Arrogant!!"

"I didn't expect that I actually got to this point."

In the territory of the Heavenly God Clan, in a magnificent tower, three powerful men dressed in luxurious and deep breath sat opposite each other, with a gloomy look in their eyes.

"Now, our tribes do not seem to have any advantages."

The powerful man from the Divine Power Clan sighed slightly, his face a little ugly.

He is referring to Lu Daosheng of the human race.

He didn't take the others seriously.

Even the three An Changzai who returned from breaking the boundary was the same.

Anyway, they could not use power higher than this world, but Lu Daosheng seemed not to be like that.

This made him feel a little uneasy.

"If we lose this time, the fate of our three tribes will probably not be much better."

As soon as these words were spoken, the powerful man from the Heavenly God Clan immediately sneered.

The leader of the Divine Power Clan and the leader of the Divine Blood Clan immediately looked at the leader of the Heavenly God Clan.

The leader of the Heavenly God clan flashed with his golden pupils, smiled evilly, and said, "Two, have you forgotten our respective origins?"

origin.

A glimmer of light flashed through the other two tribes' eyes.

The head of the Tianshen clan smiled even more.

"Yes, we are descendants of God."

.........

"Lord of the Palace, what should those guys outside deal with?"

At this time, Wu Shang spoke.

What he was referring to was naturally the patriarchs of those small tribes who were still kneeling outside the human race.

Without the leaders of the three major clans, although they are some of their strengths, they still dare not even make a fuck when facing the human race.

Hearing this, Lu Xue had no expression on her face and didn't even think about it. She said directly: "Kill all of them and transport all the resources from these tribes back to the human race."

"Also, among these tribes, you know what to do."

After hearing Lu Xue's words, Wu Shang was silent for two seconds before turning around and leaving.

After walking outside the hall, Wu Shang came back to his senses.

"This palace master is really not easy."

Lu Xue's actions are undoubtedly the best result for today's human race.

Although the human race now has strong top combat power, the fault is very serious.

It is already difficult to accept a Shadow Clan.

If these small tribes are added together, let alone management, they may be able to directly occupy the human race.

So the best way is to ignore it.

If you plunder the resources in their clan, you will not only strengthen yourself, but also weaken these small clans.

After this, these little tribes may never be able to make any big waves again.

After Wu Shang left, Lu Xue looked at the information of the three powerful clans on the table and fell into deep thought.

After pondering for a long time, Lu Xue found someone.

"Lord of the Palace, please look for me."

An old man with pale hair and wrinkles walked slowly towards the hall with a staggering pace.

Seeing this, Lu Xue stood up and stepped forward to support her.

This made the old man flattered and waved his hands repeatedly.

"Lord of the Palace, I am okay, I am okay."

Lu Xue chuckled, "Old Liang, it's okay. After all, you are the oldest senior in the human race now."

That’s right, the old man in front of him is the oldest senior in the human race now.

Lu Xue came to him and wanted to ask some things that were a long time ago.

With a light wave, there was an extra chair in the hall.

Mr. Liang is the first to have a seat in the Human Emperor Hall.

Lu Daosheng taught her since she was a child to respect the elderly and love the young, so Lu Xue respected Liang Lao especially.

"Old Liang, please sit down."

Mr. Liang no longer gave in to this and sat down tremblingly.

"I wonder what the Lord Lord of the Palace is looking for me?"

Mr. Liang asked with a charitable smile.

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue stopped talking and said directly: "Old Liang, I have read some of the books recorded in the human race, and I found that the records of the six powerful races today seem to be very vague."

"Especially the Heavenly God Clan, the Divine Power Clan and the Divine Blood Clan."
